:::{#def-ppv}
#### Positive predictive value (PPV)

The **positive predictive value**
[@wikipedia_positive_and_negative_predictive_values] of a diagnostic test is the probability
that the person tested has the disease ($D$),
given that the test is positive ($+$):

$$\text{PPV} \eqdef \Pr(D \mid +)$$ {#eq-ppv}

:::
